title: The Agent-Ready Web
subtitle: How to make your website work for AI agents, layer by layer
author: Maxim Salnikov
tested_with: Standards, specifications and tools checked as of {checked_as_of}
description: A practical book for whole web teams on making a website work for AI agents: semantic HTML, structured data, llms.txt, crawler controls, APIs and MCP, WebMCP, agent identity, security, privacy and measurement, built up layer by layer on one running example.
tagline: AI agents already read, click and call tools on your site. This book shows every person on a web team how to make that work on purpose, one layer at a time, and how to measure it.
